properties.name: TAUNT_CENSORED_MODE
properties.description: Should lighter version of taunts be used?

properties.name: TAUNT_SHOW_POPUP_BOX
properties.description: Should enemy taunts be shown in popup boxes?

properties.name: TAUNT_SHOW_IN_LOG
properties.description: Should enemy taunts be shown in log?

properties.name: TAUNT_MAKE_NOISE
properties.description: If true, taunts are treated like noises - will be shown only if there's someone close enough to hear them.

properties.name: TAUNT_ONLY_VISIBLE_ENEMIES
properties.description: If true, only enemies seen by player taunt (blocks possibilty of enemy betraying his position by taunting).

properties.name: TAUNT_SHOW_POPUP_BOX_IF_HEARD
properties.description: If true, popup box will be shown over enemy if he's heard but not seen (only works if TAUNT_MAKE_NOISE is true).

properties.name: TAUNT_SHOW_IN_LOG_IF_HEARD
properties.description: If true, taunt will be shown in log even if it's heard but taunting enemy is unseen (only works if TAUNT_MAKE_NOISE is true).

properties.name: TAUNT_ALWAYS_SHOW_POPUP_BOX
properties.description: If true, popup box will be always shown (only works if TAUNT_MAKE_NOISE is false).

properties.name: TAUNT_ALWAYS_SHOW_IN_LOG
properties.description: If true, popup box will be always shown (only works if TAUNT_MAKE_NOISE is false).

properties.name: TAUNT_VOICE
properties.description: If true, will play sound file instead of showing text.

properties.name: TAUNT_VOICE_SHOW_INFO
properties.description: If true, will show debug info when playing voice taunt.

properties.name: TAUNT_VOLUME
properties.description: How loud enemy taunt? (For comparison - Desert Eagle shot = 60)

properties.name: TAUNT_MOD_DELAY
properties.description: Add how much longer every taunt should be displayed (in ms)

properties.name: TAUNT_MIN_DELAY
properties.description: Minimum delay before taunt automatically disappears (in ms)

properties.name: TAUNT_MAX_DELAY
properties.description: Maximum delay before taunt automatically disappears (in ms)
